expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Twelve days, three countries and one flight. Kathmandu, the Bhutanese dzongs, then overland through Sikkim to Darjeeling.
expert.tip: Pack for two climates. Kathmandu and Siliguri are warm at sea level while Paro and Gangtok are cold after dark all year.

summary: 12 days through Kathmandu, Paro, Thimphu, Phuentsholing, Kalimpong, Gangtok, Darjeeling, with 11 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the kathmandu sightseeing tour, the paro half day sightseeing tour, the hike to the tiger's nest, the thimphu sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 11 nights across Kathmandu, Paro, Thimphu, Phuentsholing, Kalimpong, Gangtok, Darjeeling with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Kathmandu sightseeing tour; the Paro half day sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Phuentsholing sightseeing tour; the Gangtok sightseeing tour; the Darjeeling sightseeing tour; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Kathmandu to Paro flight; Nepal, Bhutan and Sikkim permits and visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
